note: Written by data/coverage_report.py; do not widen it by hand. This is the ONLY place a coverage category may be written (tests/test_coverage_source.py). It states the LAUNCH scope (owner, 3 Nov 2026: every High Court is in v1) over what the corpus holds. The served collection `kanoon_v1` does NOT yet hold it: on 4 Nov 2026 it serves the Supreme Court and Central Acts only (455,755 points); the High Courts, State Acts and regulations are in legal_corpus_v1/v2, acts_india and acts_noncentral_v1, and reach users only when the launch collection is built (PRD-v2 section 7, items 19 and 24). Held means in the corpus, not complete: 2,865,144 whole cases (18.26%) have no chunk in Qdrant (A141, open), and there is no length exclusion (owner). The five statutes the Act inventory found absent from the served collection (CrPC 1973, Consumer Protection 1986, Payment of Gratuity 1972, Employees' Compensation 1923, the Constitution) count as held: their text is in the dataset and staged in acts_noncentral_v1, filed under State Acts, and they are searchable once A133 is promoted; CrPC is 14 state-tagged copies, so which copy is served is a separate decision. The Indian Trusts Act 1882 is not in the dataset at all. OWNER ITEM, not resolved here: the sentence ends 'anything after the data-as-of date', and the snapshot is labelled v2026.08 while the latest Supreme Court judgment held is dated 6 November 2025 (reported by the SC lane), so that date may be months after the content it describes.
